newsitem.title: USA: Continental signs Gulfstream regional pact.
newsitem.headline: Continental signs Gulfstream regional pact.

text.p: Continental Airlines announced on Wednesday it entered an agreement with Gulfstream International to provide regional connections for Continental passengers within Florida and to the Bahamas.

Beginning in April, Gulfstream will provide more than 160 connections daily within Florida and from Florida to Nassau, Freeport and three other Bahamas destinations. Continental will handle the reservations.

"This agreement allows Continental customers access to both business and leisure destinations through check-in, competitive fares and accrual of OnePass frequent flyer mileage for the entire trip," said Tom Barber, Continental's vice president for alliance operations.
Gulfstream, headquartered in Miami Springs, Fla., operates major hubs in Tampa and Fort Lauderdale.
